Santa.style: Papá Noel on holiday in Montevideo, about to order a 3D-printed viking chess set from his friend, reading his questions one by one off his long Christmas list: a big, jolly old man with a deep, slightly gravelly, warm voice. Quick comic timing, eager and a little impatient, firing each question as soon as he gets the last answer. Clear, well-articulated words. Last line: delighted, unrolling the rest of his very long list, he just discovered he has many more questions.

Mago.style: El Mago, a kind, older wizard from Montevideo with a warm voice and a playful smile, patiently answering his friend's questions about a chess set he prints in 3D. The first four lines: calm, clear, reassuring, short and to the point, a craftsman who knows his work. Fifth line: completely deadpan and dry, a little pause after 'Las demás'. Last line: warm and inviting, straight to the viewer.
lines: Te paso precio y fecha antes de empezar.
Para jugar. Tamaño torneo, o más grande.
Va aparte: yo hago las piezas.
Comentá duda y te contesto, con precio y fecha.

_note: the automatic split put 'Para jugar.' at the end of m1 (its pause before 'Tamaño torneo' was 1.4 s, longer than the gap between lines): m1 and m2 were re-cut by hand from the take at the measured pauses (_cuts_from_take, take seconds) with the split's own trim filter; m2's inner pause shortened to 0.35 s, m5's deadpan pause after 'Las demás' to 0.45 s (raw-clip times)
